description: Actual results of the Problem 9 run (one reset at the start, no reset between tickets). Built from output/audit_trail.json (entries after index 233) and data/campus_customs_new.db. Every agent call used gpt-6-luna via Portkey.

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee (1 x CC-TEE-WHITE size S for Tauhid Zaman)
tickets.outcome: Size S was out of stock. Overdue invoice 501 was paid to unblock Bulldog Print Co, then a 1-unit restock purchase order ($8, earliest arrival 2026-09-05) was paid. Customer draft #3 tells Tauhid the restock is paid and the date is an estimate.

runs.note: Waited on a customer reply that cannot arrive (drafts are never sent).
PermissionError replacing audit_trail.json (file briefly locked) after PO request #3 was queued and approved. No run_end entry.

agent_contributions.Boss: Assigned stock, invoice and draft work; blocked the ticket in run 1; after the completion rules were added, asked for the 1-unit purchase order, confirmed both payments were executed and resolved the ticket.
agent_contributions.Inventory: Confirmed 0 on hand for CC-TEE-WHITE S (1-unit shortfall, $8 restock), matched Bulldog Print Co (5-day lead) and reported it was blocked by invoice 501 and later able to ship. Handed invoice 501 to Accounting.
agent_contributions.Accounting: Checked invoice 501 and cash, queued request #1 (invoice 501, $840), later queued request #3 (purchase order 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE S, $8) and verified both were executed with $152 left.
agent_contributions.Customer Service: Saved draft #1 (out of stock, asked whether to wait) and the final draft #3 (restock paid, earliest arrival 2026-09-05 as an estimate). Nothing was sent.

human_approvals.what: Overdue invoice 501 (rush reprint CC-TEE-WHITE S, due 2026-08-28)
Purchase order: 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE size S (PO invoice #502, ETA 2026-09-05)

tickets.subject: Rent due (Elm City Properties, lease 1)
tickets.outcome: The notice matched lease 1 ($2,400, due 2026-09-02). Rent request #2 was approved and paid, lease next_due moved to 2026-10-02, and the Boss resolved the ticket in the same run.

runs.note: MCP server session failed to initialize while ticket 101 was running. No agent ran and nothing changed.

agent_contributions.Boss: Sent the ticket to Facilities, cross-checked cash and requests, saw request #2 executed after the human approval and resolved the ticket.
agent_contributions.Accounting: Queued request #2 (rent, lease 1, $2,400) for human approval, noting $160 would remain.
agent_contributions.Facilities: Verified lease 1 against the notice (amount, landlord, due 2026-09-02, 2 days out, cash covers it) and handed the payment to Accounting.

human_approvals.what: Chapel Street shop rent for the period due 2026-09-02

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount (20 x CC-HOOD-NAVY size M for Yale AI Club)
tickets.outcome: 8 of 20 were in stock. The 12-unit restock ($264) exceeded the cash left ($160, then $152), so no purchase order was made. Final offer: 8 hoodies at $50 each (list $58, cost $22), explained in customer draft #4.
tickets.cash_note: No cash impact: no payment or purchase was requested, and no revenue is modeled.

runs.note: Waited on a customer reply or more funds, neither of which can arrive.

agent_contributions.Boss: Chose the $50 above-cost price and the 8-unit partial offer, decided not to fund the restock, and resolved the ticket in run 2. The price was compared with the $22 unit cost from check_stock_and_pricing; check_discount_margin was not called.
agent_contributions.Inventory: Confirmed 8 on hand and a 12-unit shortfall ($264 at $22), and that Bulldog Print Co can ship with a 5-day lead. Handed the restock question to Accounting.
agent_contributions.Accounting: Declined to queue the $264 purchase order because cash was short ($104 short in run 1, $112 in run 2); confirmed there were no pending commitments.
agent_contributions.Customer Service: Saved draft #2 (offer, asked whether to proceed) and the final draft #4 (8 at $50 each; the other 12 can't be supplied now). Nothing was sent.

issues_found: Run 4e2821ecc0fc (ticket 101) crashed with PermissionError [WinError 5] while replacing output/audit_trail.json, probably a brief OneDrive or other file lock. It has no run_end entry and one audit entry was lost. Fixed in backend/audit.py: retries, an in-memory backlog, and audit failures no longer crash agent runs.
Run ec82eb3fc950 (ticket 102) failed to start: 'Client failed to connect: Failed to initialize server session'. No agent work and no database change. The cause was not confirmed.

Runs 721c779fd208 (101) and f69dc5813a1c (103) ended blocked, waiting for customer replies or funds that this simulation can never provide. Completion rules were added to backend/prompts/boss.md and accounting.md before the reruns.
Earlier drafts #1 (101) and #2 (103) are still on the board alongside the final drafts #3 and #4; drafts cannot be deleted through the MCP tools.
